name: misina-t1-body-ts
instr:
Can't run authenticated API workflows in our service

Our service uses `misina` to collect paginated records and submit jobs to external APIs. I need its request helpers and plugins working together so we can handle authentication, failures, and job completion while keeping typed responses and request telemetry.

```ts
import { createMisina } from "misina"
import { bearer } from "misina/auth"
import { paginate } from "misina/paginate"
const api = createMisina({ baseURL: "https://records.example.com", use: [bearer("service-token")] })
const records: unknown[] = []
for await (const record of paginate(api, "/records")) records.push(record)
```

This should collect records using the documented authentication and pagination behavior. Instead, the helpers throw `Error("not implemented")`, and the other integration paths are blocked too.

The unfinished code spans these files in the package:

- Request support: `src/_catch.ts`, `src/_compress.ts`, `src/_merge.ts`, `src/_retry.ts`, and `src/driver/mock.ts`.
- Errors and typed validation: `src/errors/base.ts`, `src/errors/http.ts`, `src/errors/index.ts`, `src/errors/network.ts`, `src/errors/timeout.ts`, and `src/typed.ts`.
- Plugins and workflows: `src/auth/index.ts`, `src/breaker/index.ts`, `src/cookie/index.ts`, `src/dedupe/index.ts`, `src/otel/index.ts`, `src/paginate/index.ts`, `src/poll/index.ts`, `src/runtime/next/index.ts`, `src/sentry/index.ts`, and `src/tracing/index.ts`.

Could you fill in these stubs following their doc com
